subject: Residency & regional cost: HelixBank follow-up and unit-econ ask
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@helixbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@helixbank.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / residency & cost questions

Thanks again for the call this morning, Rachel — quick recap and the asks we took away on our side.

Summary from HelixBank (Ayesha):
- Primary requirement: all customer PII and model logs must remain in-region (EU) for the pilot.
- Expected pilot volume: 2–5M generation tokens / month initially, with possible spike to ~20M if pilot expands. Embeddings usage will be on a smaller footprint (~500k–1M tokens).
- Procurement timeline: decision-in-principle in ~3 weeks; procurement + legal to finish in ~6 weeks if pricing aligns.

Ask to Redwood: ballpark unit economics so we can map to our budget bands — specifically: a) $/1M tokens for hosted EU (data residency) and b) $/1M tokens for hosted US (if we decide to accept cross-border), plus any fixed minimums or reserved-capacity discounts you offer. Also please call out which parts of the premium are one-time vs recurring (eg: setup/ingress, egress, encryption/HSM, SOC2 evidence).

Budget: internal stakeholders are targeting a pilot budget in the €6k–€28k / month range (depending on model and SLA). We know that's broad — a few example pricing points (low / mid / high) will help speed internal alignment.

Deliverable request: can you provide a short table (ballpark) that maps token volume -> monthly cost (1M, 5M, 10M, 20M) for both US-hosted and EU-hosted? If you can attach an example token projection sheet that we can drop our numbers into, that would be great.

Thanks — copying Tom (ops) and we'll loop in procurement after your numbers.

Regards,
Ayesha
Director, AI Integrations
HelixBank

--
Attachment: (will share our internal token projection.xlsx in follow-up)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@helixbank.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@helixbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / residency & cost questions

Ayesha — thanks for the clear summary and the budget band. Quick reply with what I can share immediately and a short plan for next steps.

Quick answer up-front:
- We can support full EU residency (data + logs) on our hosted offering. There is a regional premium versus US-hosted instances driven by infra costs, network/egress, and compliance staffing.
- I attached a one-page cost breakdown (redwood_eu_us_cost_breakdown.pdf) and a simple token projection template (HelixBank_token_estimates.xlsx) for you to drop in your numbers.

Ballpark table we’ll refine once you confirm volumes, but to get moving here are three illustrative scenarios (generation-only, standard-generation model):
- 1M tokens / month: US-hosted ~€1,800 per 1M | EU-hosted ~€2,300 per 1M
- 5M tokens / month: US-hosted ~€1,500 per 1M (volume discount) | EU-hosted ~€1,900 per 1M
- 20M tokens / month: US-hosted ~€1,200 per 1M | EU-hosted ~€1,540 per 1M

Notes on the premium: the EU delta (~18–28% in these examples) breaks down into:
- infra price delta (higher VM + storage costs in our EU region)
- additional encryption & KMS region setup (one-time configuration fee in some cases)
- compliance/attestation effort for in-region logging and audit trails (operational overhead)
- network egress if you pull results out of region (we can avoid this with in-region delivery).

Variables we need from you to firm these up:
1) Confirm expected steady-state monthly tokens (pick a conservative and aggressive estimate).
2) Split between generation vs embeddings (embeddings are priced differently).
3) Target SLA (standard hosted SLA vs reserved/dedicated). Reserved capacity can materially reduce $/1M.

Next steps I propose:
- You drop the pilot numbers into the attached spreadsheet and forward back.
- Marcus (cc'ed) will provide a short reserved-capacity quote and a clearer $/1M with committed terms.
- We schedule a 30-min procurement alignment next week to discuss PO and SOC2 checklist.

If the budget band you shared (€6k–€28k) is the pilot monthly guidance, attach the filled template and we’ll map the scenarios back to concrete quotes.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
Office: +1 415 555 0123

Attachment: redwood_eu_us_cost_breakdown.pdf; HelixBank_token_estimates.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@helixbank.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / residency & cost questions

Ayesha — adding a bit more color on unit economics and an example projection so procurement has concrete numbers to react to.

Concrete example (generation-focused, standard model family):
- US-hosted baseline: €1,450 per 1M tokens (with 12-month reserved capacity at 20M tokens/mo). Without reservation, expect +18–25%.
- EU-hosted baseline (same commit): €1,770 per 1M tokens (approx +22% from US in this example).

Example monthly line items for 5M tokens (EU-hosted, standard SLA):
- Base inference compute + memory amortization: €6,900
- KV cache & batching efficiency savings (pass-through): -€900
- Storage + audit logs (in-region): €450
- Support & compliance amortization (SOC2, attestations): €350
- Estimated total: ~€6,800 (equivalent €1,360 / 1M tokens after some discounts applied) — this illustrates how a committed profile lowers unit price.

Embeddings: typically ~2–3x cheaper per token for our models (depending on model family), so if you have 1M embedding tokens expect an additional ~€400–€700 / month on top.

One-time items (call these out to procurement explicitly):
- EU KMS/HSM setup: one-time €1,200 (if you require dedicated HSM keys).
- In-region integration & PI redaction script: estimated €1,800 one-time professional services (optional).

I attached a quick workbook with the above examples populated; you can change volume cells to see revised monthly totals. If HelixBank can signal a 12-month commit at >=10M tokens/mo we can tighten EU premium to ~+12% instead of ~+22%.

Happy to jump on the procurement call Rachel suggested and walk through the workbook.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Finance, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: HelixBank_token_estimates.xlsx (populated with US/EU example rows)
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@helixbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@helixbank.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixbank.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / residency & cost questions

Thanks both — that level of detail is exactly what procurement needed. I dropped our conservative/aggressive numbers into the workbook and attached it (HelixBank_token_estimates.xlsx). Key notes from our side:
- Pilot target: 3M tokens/mo (generation) + 750k embeddings (month 1–3).
- If pilot goes well, expansion planned to 15M tokens/mo by Q3.
- Procurement is comfortable with a 6–12 month commit but wants supplier-side clarity on EU-residency operational SLAs (audit logs retention, access controls, and KMS ownership).

Next steps:
1) Marcus — can you produce a formal 6-month pilot quote (EU-hosted) with the one-time items called out and a short note on how a 12-month commit changes unit price?
2) Rachel — please send SOC2 + regional SLA artifact links we can share with procurement (they've asked for sample audit logs retention policy).
3) Schedule a 30-min procurement alignment for next Tue (I've proposed 2027-04-13 09:00 CEST in the calendar invite).

Thanks again — looking forward to the pilot quote.

Ayesha Khan
Director, AI Integrations
HelixBank
